sql: SELECT c.`Segment`, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS percentage_increase FROM `customers` c JOIN `yearmonth` y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY c.Segment;
